newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion sees 1997 pre-tax profit up on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Orion sees 1997 pre-tax profit up on 1996.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals maker Orion-Yhtyma Oy on Wednesday repeated an earlier forecast that full-year-1997 pre-tax profit was expected to improve slightly on 1996.
"Profit before taxes is estimated to improve slightly from that of the previous year," Orion said in a statement with its January-April results.
In 1996, the group's pre-tax profit was 759 million markka, and profit after financial items, before extraordinaries and tax was 738 million markka.
Acting CEO Pauli Torkko told a news conference that analysts' forecasts for Orion's 1997 profit made before the release of its four-month earnings were on the high side.
In a Reuters poll on June 5, the median of 10 analysts' forecasts for Orion's full-year profit before extras and tax was 802 million markka (mean 803 million) in a 720-890 million markka range.

Torkko said the rise in Orion's full-year 1997 operating profit would be about the same as last year, but it was likely that there would be no improvement in net financial items similar to last year's. @
